== ConLeche/Denotes.lean#L270-L290
   270  structure Model (V : Type w) [SetTheory V] (env : Env) where
   271    /-- the set a constant denotes, per level assignment -/
   272    cval : Name → (LevelParam → Nat) → V
   273    /-- every stored constant is a member of what its type denotes, at
   274    every level assignment (and every variable environment — the type
   275    is closed) -/
   276    mem : ∀ c ∈ env.consts, ∀ (φ : LevelParam → Nat) (ρ : BVarIdx → V),
   277      ∃ T, Denotes cval env φ ρ c.toConstantVal.type T ∧ cval c.name φ ∈ˢ T
   278    /-- whatever the built-in `False` denotes is the empty set -/
   279    false_empty : ∀ (φ : LevelParam → Nat) (ρ : BVarIdx → V) (F : V),
   280      Denotes cval env φ ρ (.const falseName []) F → F = empty
   281    /-- whatever the built-in `Eq` denotes is set equality: at a type `A`
   282    of the universe the level `u` names, and two of its members `a` and
   283    `b`, `@Eq.{u} A a b` denotes the truth value of `a = b`.  The three
   284    membership premises are the graph's domains — `Eq`'s denotation is a
   285    three-fold graph over `univ (Level.eval φ u)`, then over `A`, then
   286    over `A` again, and a graph read off its domain says nothing -/
   287    eq_equality : ∀ (u : Level) (φ : LevelParam → Nat) (ρ : BVarIdx → V) (E A a b : V),
   288      Denotes cval env φ ρ (.const eqName [u]) E →
   289      A ∈ˢ univ (Level.eval φ u) → a ∈ˢ A → b ∈ˢ A →
   290      app (app (app E A) a) b = eqv a b

    99  from the meta-logic (`Classical.choice`); see the module docstring. -/

== ConLeche/Semantics/Interp.lean#L150-L160
   150  noncomputable def interp : (Nat → V) → AnnotTerm → V
   151    | ρ, .bvar i => ρ i
   152    | _, .sort u => univ u
   153    | _, .const c us => bval V c us
   154    | ρ, .app f a => SetTheory.app (interp ρ f) (interp ρ a)
   155    | ρ, .lam v A b => lamR v (interp ρ A) fun x => interp (cons x ρ) b
   156    | ρ, .pi _ v A B => piR v (interp ρ A) fun x => interp (cons x ρ) B
   157    | ρ, .eqE a b => eqv (interp ρ a) (interp ρ b)
   158    | ρ, .fst e => sfst (interp ρ e)
   159    | ρ, .snd e => ssnd (interp ρ e)
   160    | _, .prf => pt

    82    | ρ, .pi _u _v A B =>
    83      WellDenoted ρ A ∧
    84      ∀ x, x ∈ˢ interp V ρ A → WellDenoted (cons x ρ) B

== ConLeche/Semantics/Syntax.lean#L66-L90
    66  inductive AnnotTerm where
    67    /-- de Bruijn index -/
    68    | bvar (i : Nat)
    69    /-- `Sort u` at a concrete level -/
    70    | sort (u : Nat)
    71    /-- a built-in constant at a concrete level instantiation -/
    72    | const (c : BConst) (us : List Nat)
    73    /-- application -/
    74    | app (f a : AnnotTerm)
    75    /-- `fun (_ : ty) => body`, where `body`'s **type** has sort `u` —
    76    the codomain numeral `interp` dispatches on (tier B's F4; the
    77    #152 resolution made it derivable, and `Annotates.lam` caches it) -/
    78    | lam (u : Nat) (ty body : AnnotTerm)
    79    /-- `(_ : ty) → body`, with `ty`'s sort `u` and `body`'s sort `v` -/
    80    | pi (u v : Nat) (ty body : AnnotTerm)
    81    /-- `@Eq _ lhs rhs`; no annotation, and no type slot either, as in
    82    `Term` (task #237) -/
    83    | eqE (lhs rhs : AnnotTerm)
    84    /-- first field of a pair -/
    85    | fst (e : AnnotTerm)
    86    /-- second field of a pair -/
    87    | snd (e : AnnotTerm)
    88    /-- the canonical (irrelevant) proof of a derivable equation -/
    89    | prf
    90    deriving Repr, Inhabited

   153  @[expose] def denoteMeta (acval : Name → (Name → Nat) → AnnotTerm)
   154      (env : Env) (φ : Name → Nat) :
   155      (d : Nat) → Expr → Option AnnotTerm
   156    | _, .sort u => some (.sort (u.eval φ))

== ConLeche/Semantics/Interp.lean#L150-L160
   150  noncomputable def interp : (Nat → V) → AnnotTerm → V
   151    | ρ, .bvar i => ρ i
   152    | _, .sort u => univ u
   153    | _, .const c us => bval V c us
   154    | ρ, .app f a => SetTheory.app (interp ρ f) (interp ρ a)
   155    | ρ, .lam v A b => lamR v (interp ρ A) fun x => interp (cons x ρ) b
   156    | ρ, .pi _ v A B => piR v (interp ρ A) fun x => interp (cons x ρ) B
   157    | ρ, .eqE a b => eqv (interp ρ a) (interp ρ b)
   158    | ρ, .fst e => sfst (interp ρ e)
   159    | ρ, .snd e => ssnd (interp ρ e)
   160    | _, .prf => pt

== ConLeche/Rules/Rel.lean#L576-L587
   576  inductive Certs (env : Env) : Nat → Bool → Expr → List Expr → Prop where
   577    | nil {d : Nat} {lic : Bool} {T : Expr} : Certs env d lic T []
   578    | skip {d : Nat} {lic : Bool} {ty body arg : Expr} {mb : BinderMeta}
   579        {rest : List Expr} :
   580        lic = true → mb.pw.isNever = true →
   581        Certs env d lic (body.instantiate1 arg) rest →
   582        Certs env d lic (.forallE ty body mb) (arg :: rest)
   583    | cert {d : Nat} {lic : Bool} {ty body arg ta : Expr} {mb : BinderMeta}
   584        {rest : List Expr} :
   585        Infer env .io d arg ta → DefEq env d ta ty →
   586        Certs env d lic (body.instantiate1 arg) rest →
   587        Certs env d lic (.forallE ty body mb) (arg :: rest)

== ConLeche/Rules/Rel.lean#L590-L594
   590  inductive DefEqList (env : Env) : Nat → List Expr → List Expr → Prop where
   591    | nil {d : Nat} : DefEqList env d [] []
   592    | cons {d : Nat} {a b : Expr} {as bs : List Expr} :
   593        DefEq env d a b → DefEqList env d as bs →
   594        DefEqList env d (a :: as) (b :: bs)

== ConLeche/Denotes.lean#L132-L135
   132  /-- `Denotes cval env φ ρ e v`: the term `e` denotes the set `v`.  See
   133  the module docstring. -/

   135      (BVarIdx → V) → Expr → V → Prop

== ConLeche/Denotes.lean#L270-L290
   270  structure Model (V : Type w) [SetTheory V] (env : Env) where
   271    /-- the set a constant denotes, per level assignment -/
   272    cval : Name → (LevelParam → Nat) → V
   273    /-- every stored constant is a member of what its type denotes, at
   274    every level assignment (and every variable environment — the type
   275    is closed) -/
   276    mem : ∀ c ∈ env.consts, ∀ (φ : LevelParam → Nat) (ρ : BVarIdx → V),
   277      ∃ T, Denotes cval env φ ρ c.toConstantVal.type T ∧ cval c.name φ ∈ˢ T
   278    /-- whatever the built-in `False` denotes is the empty set -/
   279    false_empty : ∀ (φ : LevelParam → Nat) (ρ : BVarIdx → V) (F : V),
   280      Denotes cval env φ ρ (.const falseName []) F → F = empty
   281    /-- whatever the built-in `Eq` denotes is set equality: at a type `A`
   282    of the universe the level `u` names, and two of its members `a` and
   283    `b`, `@Eq.{u} A a b` denotes the truth value of `a = b`.  The three
   284    membership premises are the graph's domains — `Eq`'s denotation is a
   285    three-fold graph over `univ (Level.eval φ u)`, then over `A`, then
   286    over `A` again, and a graph read off its domain says nothing -/
   287    eq_equality : ∀ (u : Level) (φ : LevelParam → Nat) (ρ : BVarIdx → V) (E A a b : V),
   288      Denotes cval env φ ρ (.const eqName [u]) E →
   289      A ∈ˢ univ (Level.eval φ u) → a ∈ˢ A → b ∈ˢ A →
   290      app (app (app E A) a) b = eqv a b

== ConLeche/Model/Denotes.lean#L222-L228
   222  theorem Denotes_of_denoteMeta {acval : Name → (Name → Nat) → AnnotTerm}
   223      (hcl : ∀ n ψ, Term.Closed (acval n ψ).erase) {env : Env} {φ : Name → Nat} :
   224      ∀ (d : Nat) (e : Expr) {ta : AnnotTerm},
   225        denoteMeta acval env φ d e = some ta →
   226        Expr.fvarsBelow d e → e.looseBVarsBounded 0 = true →
   227        ∀ ρ : Nat → V, WellDenotedV V ρ ta →
   228          Denotes (cvalOf (V := V) acval) env φ ρ (closeN d e) (interp V ρ ta) := by
